description: Isoform division of labour across tissues and brain cell types, testing paralogue compensation
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14.5, 4.6))

# Panel A: tissue-level nTPM (HPA "RNA tissue specific nTPM")
tis = {"ATP1A2":{"skeletal muscle":825.7,"brain":582.8,"tongue":446.6},
       "ATP1A3":{"brain":279.0,"retina":271.7,"heart muscle":147.7}}
ax=axes[0]
labels=["skeletal\nmuscle","brain","tongue","retina","heart\nmuscle"]
a2=[825.7,582.8,446.6,0,0]; a3=[0,279.0,0,271.7,147.7]
x=np.arange(len(labels)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,a2,w,label="ATP1A2",color="#c0392b")
ax.bar(x+w/2,a3,w,label="ATP1A3",color="#2874a6")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=8.5); ax.set_ylabel("nTPM (HPA tissue-enriched)")
ax.set_title("A. Tissue enrichment\nATP1A1 = low tissue specificity (ubiquitous)",fontsize=9.5)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)

# Panel B: single-nuclei brain specificity
ax=axes[1]
cells=["Pericytes","Inhibitory\nneurons","Excitatory\nneurons","Other\nneurons"]
v2=[5625.5,0,0,0]; v3=[0,467.9,268.4,237.0]
x=np.arange(len(cells))
ax.bar(x-w/2,v2,w,label="ATP1A2",color="#c0392b")
ax.bar(x+w/2,v3,w,label="ATP1A3",color="#2874a6")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(cells,fontsize=8.5); ax.set_ylabel("nCPM (HPA single-nuclei brain)")
ax.set_title("B. Human brain single-nuclei specificity\nATP1A2 'cell type enhanced: pericytes'",fontsize=9.5)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)

# Panel C: division of labour schematic
ax=axes[2]; ax.axis("off")
rows=[("ATP1A1","all cell types\n(low specificity)","#7f8c8d"),
      ("ATP1A2","pericytes, astrocytes,\nskeletal muscle, tongue","#c0392b"),
      ("ATP1A3","neurons\n(inhibitory > excitatory)","#2874a6")]
for i,(g,t,c) in enumerate(rows):
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.03,0.74-0.30*i),0.94,0.24,fc=c,alpha=0.18,ec=c,lw=1.4))
    ax.text(0.09,0.86-0.30*i,g,fontsize=11,weight="bold",color=c,va="center")
    ax.text(0.40,0.86-0.30*i,t,fontsize=9,va="center")
ax.set_title("C. Non-overlapping cellular niches:\nno paralogue occupies the ATP1A2 compartment",fontsize=9.5)
ax.text(0.03,0.02,"Source: Human Protein Atlas (HPA) consensus RNA, retrieved this work",
        fontsize=7.5,style="italic",color="#555555")

plt.suptitle("Na+/K+-ATPase alpha isoforms partition by cell type, so ATP1A1 and ATP1A3 cannot cover an ATP1A2 null",
             fontsize=11.5,y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
